tobs_minigames
==============

1. Put the "tobs_minigames" folder in your resources folder.
2. Add this line to server.cfg:   ensure tobs_minigames
3. Restart the server and type /minigame in game to try every minigame.

No framework, database, items or other resources needed. Settings: tobs_minigames/config.lua
For script makers: tobs_minigames/EXPORTS.md
